answer: One workable design: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because comet only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, willow is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any marble approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
